dt: Proposals accepted anytime; contact XC program directors before proposals over $50,000
e: Supports materials-community activities that span several DMR programs, such as summer schools, institutes, workshops and conferences, plus REU/RET site and international/education activities; it does not take standard research proposals. Open to US universities; no citizenship restriction.
n: NSF DMR Crosscutting Activities in Materials Research (XC): workshops, summer schools, REU/RET
